name: dialog
description: Modal dialog with focus trap, escape-to-close, and overlay backdrop

changes.note: Nested components keep their own parts. The stylesheet reached every part with descendant selectors, so a component in the body with parts of the same name took the dialog's styles: a popover's close button was squashed to the dialog's 32px icon square, a sheet's header and title were laid out as the dialog's. Kept beyond direct children: the header, body and footer may be children of a <form> that is the panel's child (a form dialog); the title and description may sit in one plain div, stack or cluster inside its section (an eyebrow above the title); the close button may be the panel's own child, or sit in the header or footer the same way. Every part rule is now a child chain from the root, with the hops in :where(), so no rule changes specificity. No change for markup that follows the template.

Nested components keep their own parts. Overlay and panel are taken as direct children, and the trigger and the close, confirm and cancel actions by owner: a part counts only when the nearest data-ui above it, looking through layout primitives (stack, cluster, grid, container, surface, switcher, aspect-ratio), is this dialog. A popover's close button inside the panel no longer closes the dialog; a close button wrapped in a stack or cluster still does.

Focus on open and close is fixed. The panel had no tabindex, so the panel.focus() call on open did nothing: focus stayed on body, outside the focus trap and out of reach of the root's Escape listener. tabindex="-1" is now in the canonical markup, and the controller adds it when it is missing. Closing also took focus back too late: focus returned to the opener only after the exit animation ended, even if the user had moved focus to another control in the meantime. Focus now returns only if it is still inside the dialog or on body, and only to an opener that is still in the document. The panel draws no focus ring of its own.

trigger.description: Button that opens the dialog. A dialog is opened by whatever the application decides — a row button in a table, a menu item, a route change — so the trigger is not always inside the dialog. Optional since 0.9-04. Carries data-ui="button": a trigger part is either a component in its own right or styled by its own recipe (the trigger contract, audit rule `trigger-contract`).

panel.description: The dialog box container. Its header, body and footer are its children, or children of a <form> that is (a form dialog).

title.description: Linked via aria-labelledby to panel. Sits in the header, directly or inside one plain div, stack or cluster (an eyebrow above the title).

description.description: Optional, linked via aria-describedby if present. Sits in the header or the body, directly or inside one plain div, stack or cluster.

close.description: Close button, must have aria-label. Sits in the panel, or in its header or footer, directly or inside one plain div, stack or cluster.

required_attrs: tabindex="-1" on panel (controller adds it if missing)
a11y.notes: Focus returns to the opener unless focus moved elsewhere while closing, or the opener has left the document. The panel carries tabindex="-1" so it can take focus on open; the controller adds it if the markup does not.
